title: Beruriah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman describes her as the one woman, out of all the daughters of Israel mentioned in the two Talmuds, who merited to take part in halakhah together with the great Tannaim of the generation.

Hyman says that she was the daughter of the Tanna renowned for his righteousness, R' Chanina ben Teradyon, who was killed for the sanctification of God's Name, one of the martyrs of the government. While still in her youth she showed that she was a great and learned woman, as is brought in [Eruvin 53b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.53b.24): Rabbi Yose the Galilean was walking along the road and met Beruriah. He said to her, 'By which way do we go to Lod?' She said to him, 'Foolish Galilean! Did the Sages not say, "Do not talk much with a woman"? You should have said, "Which to Lod?"' And, as Hyman says is well known, Rabbi Yose the Galilean was a colleague of R' Akiva; therefore, he concludes, this must necessarily have been in her youth.[^3]

And in [the Tosefta of Kelim, Bava Metzia, chapter 1](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosefta_Kelim_Metzia.1.3), they said: Regarding a kalustra (a door fitting), R' Tarfon declares it impure while the Sages declare it pure, and Beruriah says: one removes it from this doorway and hangs it on another on Shabbat. When her words were stated before R' Yehoshua — and Hyman reports the Gra’s reading as R' Yehudah [ben Bava] — he said, 'Beruriah has spoken well.'[^1][^2]

Hyman quotes: And in [the Tosefta of Kelim, Bava Kamma, chapter 4, halakhah 9](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosefta_Kelim_Kamma.4.9): An oven — from when is its purification? R' Chalafta of Kfar Chananya said: I asked Shimon ben Chananyah, who had asked R' Chanina ben Teradyon, and he said: from when it is moved from its place; but his daughter says: from when they strip off its sheath. When these statements were made before R' Yehudah ben Bava, he said, 'His daughter has spoken better than he.'[^4]

notes.text: A kalustra is a door fitting. Beruriah allows it to be moved from one doorway to another on Shabbat.
The linked Kelim Metzia names Rabbi Yehoshua as the one who praises Beruriah. Hyman reports Yehudah as the Gra’s reading and supplies [ben Bava].

The linked Eruvin gives Beruriah’s shorter question about Lod. [Heilprin’s Beruriah entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=811&lang=en) discusses the door-fitting ruling and flags the attribution to Rabbi Yehoshua for further examination. Hyman infers that this happened in her youth.

The linked Kelim Kamma has Shimon ask the son of Rabbi Chanina ben Teradyon. Hyman has him ask Rabbi Chanina himself. The Hebrew linked here ends “his daughter spoke better than he.” The linked English instead gives “better than his son,” citing Vienna and the Gra. The supplied extract ends on [Hyman’s printed p. 294](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3f/Aaron_Hyman._Toldoth_Tannaim_veAmoraim._I._1910.pdf#page=325); the biography continues beyond it.
